risk_signals.text_excerpt: Azure faces diverse competition from cloud service providers and open source offerings. Azure’s competitive advantage includes enabling a hybrid cloud, allowing deployment of existing datacenters with our public cloud into a single, cohesive infrastructure, and the ability to run at a scale that meets the needs of businesses of all sizes and complexities. Our AI offerings compete with AI products from hyperscalers, as well as products from other emerging competitors and other open source offerings, many of which are also current or potential partners.
evidence_chain: Azure faces diverse competition from cloud service providers
Our AI offerings compete with AI products from hyperscalers
Indicates intense competition and rapid technology evolution
risk_signals.accounting_meaning: High competition in cloud/AI infrastructure suggests rapid technology changes, relevant for D5.

risk_signals.text_excerpt: We may experience supply or quality problems. There are limited suppliers for certain device and datacenter components. We continue to identify and evaluate opportunities to expand our datacenter locations and increase our server capacity to meet the evolving needs of our customers, particularly given the growing demand for AI services. Capacity available to us may be affected as competitors use some of the same suppliers and materials for hardware components. If components are delayed or become unavailable, whether because of supplier capacity constraint, industry shortages, legal or regulatory changes that restrict supply sources, or other reasons, we may not obtain timely replacement supplies, resulting in reduced sales or inadequate datacenter capacity to support the delivery and continued development of our products and services.
evidence_chain: There are limited suppliers for certain device and datacenter components
If components are delayed or become unavailable... resulting in reduced sales or inadequate datacenter capacity
Potential impact on revenue and operations
risk_signals.accounting_meaning: Supply chain risks could affect ability to maintain infrastructure, indirectly impacting asset utilization.

dimension_scores.dimension_name: Depreciation Life vs Technology Useful Life
dimension_scores.reasoning: No explicit disclosure of server useful life or depreciation policy in the provided excerpts. Cannot assess.
Historical extension exists (2022 change from 4y to 6y) but no change this year. Based on profile, D2=4.
Indirect signals only: risk factors mention obsolescence and supply chain issues, but no actual impairment charge disclosed. Also, no PP&E impairment mentioned. Score 3.
CAPEX increased by $20.1B in FY2025. Based on profile, MSFT CAPEX intensity is around 23% (cash) or 30% including finance leases, which falls in 15-25% range. Score 4.
Microsoft directly operates massive GPU/AI infrastructure (Azure + OpenAI) and acknowledges intense competition and rapid technology evolution. Score 5.

ai_raw.summary: Microsoft's FY2025 10-K reveals significant capital expenditures and intense competition in AI/cloud, but lacks explicit disclosure of server depreciation policy. Historical extension of useful life (2022) remains in force, indicating moderate conservatism. Impairment signals are indirect, with no actual PP&E impairment disclosed. Overall, the company faces high technology substitution risk due to its massive AI infrastructure investments.
